purpose: Govern Work Order to Command Plan to provider execution across Host Commander, Device Authority and other LeeWay capabilities.
interpretationLaw: Formula decimal/base64 output is a ranked encoded state and receives no standalone operational semantics. The domain-policy interpreter consumes measured domain state + verified Formula execution evidence and may emit only the bounded action vocabulary declared by this contract.

definitions.work_order_valid: 1 only when capability, target, arguments and risk class are structurally valid.
definitions.provider_authorized: 1 only when a registered provider is available and authorized for the requested risk/consent state.
definitions.execution_verified: 1 only when postcondition/harness verifies real execution.
definitions.receipt_integrity: 1 only when required provider and C3 receipt hashes are present.
definitions.truthful_block_or_recovery: 1 when an unavailable/unauthorized request is explicitly BLOCKED or a failed execution enters bounded repair/retest; 0 for silent/fabricated success.
definitions.formula_authority_ready: 1 only when canonical Formula source hashes and live diagnostic health are verified before the work-order decision.

policy: The frozen Formula evaluates a 16-row measured capability history. The domain-policy interpreter applies the latest work order: valid+authorized+verified+receipted -> EXECUTE_VERIFIED; approval-required -> HOLD_FOR_APPROVAL; unavailable/unauthorized provider -> BLOCK_PROVIDER; executed but unverified -> REPAIR_AND_RETEST. Formula numeric values receive no invented operational semantics.
